note: Keys carrying the ENGLISH text in a non-English catalogue, because the translation wave for them has not run yet. Identical on screen to the fallback lib/i18n.tsx already makes for a missing key; listed here so a later sweep can find them, since a seeded string is otherwise indistinguishable from a translated one. check-untranslated.mjs holds this file and the catalogues together: translate a key and its entry must go, or the check fails.
